About Evade Research

Make the market
more understandable.

Evade Research is a newsletter concept built around a gap: beginners can access more financial information than ever, yet still struggle to turn it into a coherent picture.

For the reader between
the lecture and the headline.

The proposed newsletter connects macroeconomics with broad US and European equity markets. It is designed for young and newer investors, including finance students, who want to understand the mechanism behind a market narrative.

It aims to reward curiosity, explain unfamiliar vocabulary and make uncertainty visible. The intended outcome is a more informed reader, not a list of securities to buy.

A research process
you can follow.

  1. Start with a specific questionDefine the market question and the information cutoff before interpreting the news.
  2. Trace facts to primary sourcesPrefer original central bank releases and official economic data. Link evidence so readers can inspect the underlying material.
  3. Separate observation from interpretationExplain the economic transmission channel. State alternative explanations and what would challenge the view.
  4. Teach one useful conceptAdd a plain-English explanation that works without assuming a finance background.
  5. Review before publicationThe intended editorial process includes checking dates, numbers, sources and language. The pilot is a historical demonstration, not a current research feed.

Our research desk.

Our proposed workflow combines reporting, event monitoring and charting, with original releases and filings as the factual foundation.

  • Bloomberg: reporting and context, using public coverage or subscriptions we hold.
  • FinancialJuice: headlines and the economic calendar to identify developments worth investigating; verify timestamps and feed delays.
  • TradingView: charts and company financial data. Check the symbol, exchange, currency and data status; verify key company figures against filings.
  • Primary sources: central banks, statistical agencies and company reports to confirm the numbers, periods and revisions.

We write our own analysis, link the evidence and distinguish facts from interpretation. This prototype has no live platform connections.

AI assistance, openly stated.

AI tools assisted with project research, drafting, financial modelling and website development. AI output can be incomplete or wrong; it should be checked against the named sources and the stated cutoff.

The project’s proposed workflow keeps editorial review and responsibility with the publisher. No automated live market monitoring, personalised investment advice or automated trade execution is implemented in this prototype.

Project status

An idea made tangible.

Created as a course assignment and portfolio project relevant to sales & trading career development. It demonstrates research communication, product thinking and a proposed newsletter business model.

It is not evidence of employment, professional certification, a track record or a live regulated service.

Our scope

Macro. Markets. Learning.

Broad US and European equity indices are the focus. Individual portfolio suitability, trade signals and personalised recommendations are outside the offer.
